description.raw: Notes from Leads UAT Feedback - AC Below Remove target insured revenue size as a required field to move from New to Funnel lead status Qualified leads should be readable and accessible by all users as a way of historical tracking (Through list view if possible) Merge records function should be allowed for when SF identifies potential duplicate records Replace Region in highlights panel with Target Insured Industry Users should be able to see all leads i.e. Aaron should have editing rights of other's records (i.e. a hierarchy where certain MRD users have read/write access but most only have read access for others' records) -  not a blocker Current Program Expiration Date field seems to be missing from page layout - this is on the page layout and called proposed expiration date and will have the label changed Upon converting a lead with broker sourced = yes and broker name selected, the relevant field on the opportunity record is not being auto populated (Broker Source) Unqualified status: Key fields does not incude unqualified reason Unqualified reason is not prompted in validation error message if it hasn’t been filled in and user attempts to change status to unqualified Ensure broker sourced field is not mandatory during new lead creation This field and the dependent lookup field should be mandatory to progress the lead from new to funnel Remove Member Qualification Action Plan as a mandatory field for when a Lead status is changed from Funnel to Converted Distribution region is required to convert lead but it is only being flagged on the conversion page. This should be made clear to the user earlier one, when they attempt to change status of lead from Funnel to Converted ? - this logic needs reviewing. Change the label of ‘Proposed Expiration Date’ to ‘Current Program Expiration Date’ Hide the ‘Series Entity’ field in the page layout - it is not required As an MRD user I want the correct lead fields to be required at the right stages of the lead lifecycle So that I can move leads through statuses without unnecessary blockers or missing mandatory information. Scenario 1: Target Insured Revenue Size is not required to move from New to Funnel   Given a Lead is in status "New"   When the user changes the status to "Funnel"   Then the system should not require the "Target Insured Revenue Size" field Scenario 2: Broker Sourced field not mandatory at creation   Given a user is creating a new Lead   When they save the record   Then the "Broker Sourced" field should not be mandatory Scenario 3: Broker Sourced and Broker Name required to progress to Funnel   Given a Lead is in status "New"   When the user changes the status to "Funnel"   Then the system should require completion of "Broker Sourced" and "Broker Name" fields Scenario 4: Member Qualification Action Plan not mandatory when converting   Given a Lead is in status "Funnel"   When the user changes the status to "Converted"   Then the system should not require the "Member Qualification Action Plan" field As an MRD user I want to ensure that unqualified leads capture the reason consistently So that reporting and analysis on disqualified leads are accurate. Scenario 1: Unqualified status includes key fields   Given a Lead status is changed to "Unqualified"   Then the "Unqualified Reason" field must be available for completion Scenario 2: Validation message shown for missing Unqualified Reason   Given a user changes a Lead’s status to "Unqualified" without completing "Unqualified Reason"   When they save the record   Then the system should display a validation error prompting completion of "Unqualified Reason" As a Salesforce user I want to see the correct fields and labels on the Lead page layout So that the layout is clear and only relevant information is displayed. Scenario 1: Replace Region with Target Insured Industry in Highlights Panel   Given the Lead record is displayed   Then the "Region" field should be removed from the highlights panel   And "Target Insured Industry" should be displayed instead Scenario 2: Change label for Proposed Expiration Date   Given a Lead record has a field labelled "Proposed Expiration Date"   Then the field label should be changed to "Current Program Expiration Date" Scenario 3: Hide Series Entity field   Given a Lead record is open   Then the "Series Entity" field should not be visible on the page layout As an MRD user I want appropriate visibility and edit rights on leads So that all users can view leads for historical tracking while maintaining data control Scenario 1: All users can see qualified leads   Given Leads exist with status "Qualified"   Then all users should be able to view these leads (e.g., via list views) Scenario 2: Users can see all leads   Given Leads exist in the system   Then all users should have at least read access to all Lead records As a Salesforce user I want the Broker Source field to be automatically populated upon lead conversion So that I don’t have to manually re-enter information already captured on the Lead. Scenario 1: Broker Source auto-populates on Opportunity   Given a Lead is converted with "Broker Sourced = Yes" and a "Broker Name" selected   When the Lead converts to an Opportunity   Then the "Broker Source" field on the Opportunity should be populated automatically with the Broker Name from the Lead As a Salesforce user I want to be able to merge duplicate lead records when the system identifies them So that data remains clean and consistent. Scenario 1: User can merge potential duplicate leads   Given Salesforce identifies potential duplicate Lead records   When the user chooses to merge them   Then the system should allow the merge process to complete successfully
